subject: Trouble deploying app that uses the 'tm' package

messages.author: 60d5b240a251bcbf
messages.subject: Trouble deploying app that uses the 'tm' package
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to deploy an app that relies on the 'tm' package, but the deployment is failing with the following error message:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 227224 failed: Error building image: Error building tm (0.6). Build exited with non-zero status: 1

Any idea on how best to proceed? 

Thanks a lot,

Alex

messages.author: 60d5b240a251bcbf
messages.subject: Re: Trouble deploying app that uses the 'tm' package
parts:
I have managed to answer my own question - ShinyApps is running instances of R 3.03 and the 'tm' package I am dependent on (v0.6) requires R v3.1. I cured the issue by 'rolling-back' the version of 'tm' that I was using to v0.5-10. 

I'm not sure if this is the most elegant solution to the problem - I'd be interested to hear of better ways around the issue.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Trouble deploying app that uses the 'tm' package
parts:
Alex,

I wanted to let you know that I just deployed a new version of the shinyapps package that will detect your version of R and then use that version on ShinyApps.

Currently R versions 3.0.0 - 3.1.0 are supported.

You can update shinyapps by running:

devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')
